info.title: SEC 10-K Filings Retrieval API
info.description: Fetches the latest Form 10-K filing from SEC EDGAR for a given stock ticker, extracts key sections, and archives the PDF to S3 for Knowledge Base ingestion.

post.summary: Fetch and ingest the latest 10-K SEC filing for a stock ticker
post.description: Use this tool ONLY when the requested company's Form 10-K filing is not found in the Knowledge Base. Retrieves the latest 10-K from SEC EDGAR by stock ticker, extracts key narrative sections (Business, Risk Factors, MD&A, Market Risk) for immediate analysis, and uploads the full PDF to S3.

200.description: Successfully retrieved 10-K sections and stored raw PDF in S3

400.description: Invalid or missing stock ticker parameter

500.description: Internal error fetching or parsing the SEC filing

ticker.description: Official US stock ticker symbol in uppercase (e.g., MSFT, AAPL, NVDA)

filing_url.description: Source SEC EDGAR URL of the retrieved Form 10-K

bucket.description: Target S3 bucket where the PDF was archived

key.description: S3 object key of the archived 10-K PDF

sections.description: Dictionary mapping extracted 10-K section titles to their text content
